size.value: 431 × 555 px at 300 dpi (≈36.5 × 47.0mm / 3.65 × 4.70cm, a direct unit conversion of the stated px/dpi values — a non-square, portrait-oriented format); file must be under 50KB, in .jpg format.

background.value: Off-white or light gray background ('un fond blanc cassé ou de couleur gris claire'), with clear contrast maintained between the face and the background.

validity.value: Photo must be taken no more than six months before the application submission date.

file_spec.value: 431 × 555 px, .jpg format, file size under 50KB, 300dpi resolution.

expression_restriction.value: Neutral facial expression, mouth closed, no smiling ('bouche fermée, pas de sourire').

ears_visibility.value: Forehead and ears must be uncovered.

face_visibility.value: Forehead and ears must be uncovered; eyes open and clearly visible; face and shoulders straight, centered, and squared to the camera.

db_conflicts.research_value: 431×555px @300dpi, which converts to ≈36.5×47.0mm (3.65×4.70cm) — a non-square, portrait-oriented format, not the square 4×4cm recorded in DB.
Off-white or light gray ('blanc cassé ou gris clair'), not pure white.

cross_verification.note_en: Source is the Madagascar Ministry of Foreign Affairs (diplomatie.gov.mg) passport photo-requirements page, fetched directly. The px/mm conversion (300dpi standard: 1 inch = 25.4mm, so 431px÷300×25.4≈36.5mm, 555px÷300×25.4≈47.0mm) is a deterministic unit conversion of the officially stated figures, not an estimate. Third-party commercial photo-service sites claim a separate '40×40mm' figure for Madagascar, but this could not be traced to an official government page and was excluded per the truthfulness gate.
